typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Member_ID as string,
		Management_Type as string,
		Effective_Date as string,
		Term_Date as string,
		Member_PCP_ID as string,
		Member_Management_Program_Name as string,
		Program_Level as string,
		Source_System as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Select   LTRIM(RTRIM([Member_ID])) AS [Member_ID] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Management_Type])) AS [Management_Type] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Effective_Date])) AS [Effective_Date] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Term_Date])) AS [Term_Date] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Member_PCP_ID])) AS [Member_PCP_ID] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Member_Management_Program_Name])) AS [Member_Management_Program_Name] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Program_Level])) AS [Program_Level] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Source_System])) AS [Source_System]  from [EXTRACT].FL_3M_Membership_Managment',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> MemberManagement
MemberManagement derive(Member_ID = Member_ID) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		Effective_Date as string,
		Member_ID as string,
		Management_Type as string,
		Program_Level as string,
		Member_Management_Program_Name as string,
		Source_System as string,
		Term_Date as string,
		Member_PCP_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Effective_Date,
		Member_ID,
		Management_Type,
		Program_Level,
		Member_Management_Program_Name,
		Source_System,
		Term_Date,
		Member_PCP_ID)) ~> MemberManagementfile
